title: Ngân sách phòng bệnh · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support directing more public health funding towards prevention rather than treatment, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Health budgets must serve people already ill as well as reduce the number who become ill later. I support increasing effective preventive spending gradually, but essential treatment must be protected while future benefits remain uncertain.

Supporters argue that prevention can avoid illness and preserve scarce clinical capacity. Reducing exposure to common risk factors lowers the need for expensive interventions later. Safe walking routes can make regular physical activity easier for people who dislike organised sport. Making activity part of an ordinary journey can reach people who would not join a gym, broadening prevention beyond those already motivated to exercise. Safer walking routes may reduce future illness, but they cannot replace treatment for patients who already require urgent clinical care.

Opponents warn that prevention programmes may deliver uncertain benefits while patients need treatment immediately. Preventive benefits often arrive after sustained participation, whereas hospitals must treat patients already ill. Moving funds too quickly can remove capacity needed today before the promised reduction in future demand has occurred, imposing immediate harm for an uncertain later saving. Governments should protect essential treatment and evaluate prevention through realistic long-term outcomes. Evaluation needs realistic time horizons and comparison with alternative uses of the budget, while immediate clinical obligations set a limit on how quickly money can shift. Budget decisions should compare realistic health gains over time while protecting essential treatment, rather than assume that every preventive programme will pay for itself. Avoiding illness can benefit many people for years, yet those gains cannot justify withdrawing urgent care before prevention reduces demand.
Prevention merits a larger role where durable health gains are credible, while the pace of reallocation must leave today’s patients with the care they cannot postpone.

review: Task Response: Kết luận trả lại cả hai cách nhìn và quyết định của người viết; không cần chia đều số câu nhưng phải giải thích thực chất cả hai phía. Đã xử lý phản biện “Prevention programmes may deliver uncertain benefits while patients need treatment immediately.” chưa?

Coherence & Cohesion: đã giải thích cơ chế và điều kiện? Không coi chi phòng bệnh luôn tiết kiệm hơn điều trị. Hiệu quả tùy chương trình và thời gian; người đang bệnh không thể chờ lợi ích dài hạn. Đề là phân bổ thêm ngân sách, không bỏ bệnh nhân hiện tại.
Lexical Resource: dùng “clinical capacity” đúng nghĩa “khả năng hệ thống y tế cung cấp dịch vụ khám chữa bệnh”, không thay thuật ngữ chính xác bằng từ hoa mỹ?
Grammar: can/could/may thể hiện khả năng chứ không chứng minh quan hệ nhân quả; mệnh đề điều kiện có nêu đúng điều kiện trong tình huống không?
